public_rationale: OpenAI introduced GPT-5 on August 7, 2025, after the December 31, 2024 deadline. That supports the forecast under the ordinary reading of GPT-5's public release.
limitations: This assesses the named public release, not private prototypes or differently named models.
It does not validate Marcus's explanation for the timing.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPT-5 will not be released in 2024.

statement.excerpt: As of today, I am more confident than ever that GPT-5 won’t land this year.
statement.document_title: GPT-5… now arriving Gate 8, Gate 9, Gate 10

our_interpretation: Land means OpenAI publicly releases a product or model named GPT-5, including initial public rollout or API availability.
The confidence wording does not supply a numerical probability. Assess the forecasted event, not his private confidence.
Differently named releases do not count as GPT-5 merely because they might have been intended as its successor.
criteria.support_condition: GPT-5 was not publicly released by December 31, 2024.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI publicly released GPT-5 on or before December 31, 2024.
